calibration.example: Legible repair intake with clear labels, familiar layout and misplaced focus after an invalid number

primary_action.expected: Show the inscribed egg and its annotation immediately.
primary_action.observed: The button changes to Back to the whole painting, but the whole painting remains dominant. Only the top of the detail is visible; the egg and annotation require scrolling.

A-1440.edge_observation: After scrolling to the detail, Enter closed it and returned to the whole painting. Focus remained visibly on Inspect the egg. Captures: A-1440-before, A-1440-after, A-1440-detail-scrolled, A-1440-edge.
A-1440.fact_check: The ring locates the egg in the lower-right nest. The transcription says Holland; the enlarged painted letters are discernible but dark and uneven, so they are less legible than the transcription. The later-defender interpretation is presented without evidence in the view and was not independently verified.
A-1440.strength: The large painting and restrained palette give the artwork prominence; the location ring connects the detail to the whole.
A-1440.weakness: The requested result is below the fold, while the right side contains substantial unused space. The accessible reading order places the whole image before the detail and repeats the egg inscription in the detail image description and annotation.
A-1440.repair: Place the crop and short annotation in the initial viewport after activation, retaining a smaller marked whole-image locator and a clear return button.

primary_action.expected: Show the egg and its complete short annotation immediately.
primary_action.observed: The full painting and detail appear in sequence. The egg is visible, but the annotation is clipped at the bottom until scrolling.

A-390.edge_observation: After ArrowDown, the full annotation appeared. Enter closed the detail and focus remained visibly on Inspect the egg. Captures: A-390-before, A-390-after, A-390-detail, A-390-edge.
A-390.fact_check: The ring marks the egg in the whole painting. At this size the painted lettering is very dark and only partly decipherable; Holland is clear in the transcription. The historical interpretation was not independently verified.
A-390.strength: The stacked layout keeps the action and marked painting easy to find.
A-390.weakness: The whole painting precedes the detail, consuming much of the viewport and pushing part of the answer below it. The image description and annotation repeat the inscription; the accessible metadata runs the artist, date and medium together without spaces.
A-390.repair: Prioritize the detail and complete annotation on opening, preserve a compact locator, and add accessible separators between metadata items.

primary_action.expected: Show the inscribed egg, annotation and location in the whole painting.
primary_action.observed: The crop, complete annotation and marked whole-painting thumbnail appear immediately in the same viewport.

B-1440.edge_observation: Enter returned to the whole painting, with visible focus retained on Inspect the egg. Captures: B-1440-before, B-1440-after, B-1440-edge.
B-1440.fact_check: The thumbnail ring identifies the egg at the right of the nest. The transcription reads Holland; the painted letters are visible but dim and uneven, and are less readily read than the transcription. The historical interpretation was not independently verified.
B-1440.strength: The detail becomes the focal point while the thumbnail preserves location and the annotation remains immediately available.
B-1440.weakness: The title and button column leaves a large vertical gap above the action. The annotation repeats the inscription stated in the detail image description, although the visible page does not repeat the fact.
B-1440.repair: Tighten the detail-state spacing and consider a larger or higher-resolution inspectable crop while retaining the transcription and locator.

primary_action.expected: Show the egg, annotation and whole-image location without additional navigation.
primary_action.observed: The complete annotation appears above the crop, alongside a small marked whole-painting thumbnail, all within the initial viewport.

B-390.edge_observation: Enter returned to the whole painting and retained visible focus on Inspect the egg. Captures: B-390-before, B-390-after, B-390-edge.
B-390.fact_check: The thumbnail ring marks the nest location, though it is tiny. The painted lettering in the mobile crop is dark and difficult to decipher independently; the transcription Holland is clear. The historical interpretation was not independently verified.
B-390.strength: The answer and location are immediately available with no scrolling.
B-390.weakness: The thumbnail competes for width, making both it and the crop small. The annotation precedes the visual detail, and the accessible metadata runs artist, date and medium together. The inscription is repeated in the detail image description and annotation.
B-390.repair: Give the crop more width, make the locator easier to inspect, and separate metadata in the accessible reading order.

preference.reason: B presents the target, annotation and marked whole-image context immediately at both widths, while preserving keyboard focus on return. A requires scrolling to see the complete answer, especially at desktop width.

calibration.rationale: Clear labels and legibility support the task; the familiar layout limits originality, and misplaced focus after validation is a material usability weakness.

primary_action.expected: Open the egg detail with its annotation and location in the whole painting.
primary_action.observed: The detail, annotation and marked overview appeared immediately. The button remained focused and changed to Back to the whole painting.

A-1440.edge_observation: Enter returned to the whole painting and retained visible focus on Inspect the egg. The marked egg is findable at the lower right of the painting.
A-1440.fact_check: The transcription says Holland. The painted letters are dark and partially discernible in the enlarged detail, but the entire word is not independently clear from these pixels. The later political interpretation is a historical claim not independently verified in this review.
A-1440.strength: The large crop and marked overview connect the detail to the painting; the annotation is immediately visible.
A-1440.weakness: The detail alt text repeats the transcription before the annotation in reading order. The title and metadata occupy a large separate column, leaving substantial unused space below.
A-1440.repair: Avoid repeating the inscription in both alt text and annotation, and use the open space to bring the annotation closer to the detail.

primary_action.expected: Show the egg detail and annotation immediately.
primary_action.observed: The annotation, detail and marked overview all appeared without scrolling; focus stayed on the return button.

A-390.edge_observation: Enter restored the whole painting and visible focus to Inspect the egg. The ring identifies the egg near the lower right.
A-390.fact_check: Holland is supplied by the annotation and repeated in the image description. The painted lettering is faint and too small to read confidently at this width; the political interpretation remains unverified.
A-390.strength: The complete task fits in the initial mobile viewport, with a clear focus indicator.
A-390.weakness: The overview takes width from the crop, reducing lettering legibility. The accessibility tree joins the artist, date and medium without spaces; the transcription is duplicated in the detail alt text.
A-390.repair: Give the crop more width, add accessible separators to the metadata, and reserve the transcription for the annotation.

primary_action.expected: Open the detail with its annotation and marked whole-image location.
primary_action.observed: The crop, overview and annotation appeared immediately; focus remained on the return button.

B-1440.edge_observation: Enter restored the whole painting and visible focus to Inspect the egg. The ring marks the egg at the lower right.
B-1440.fact_check: The annotation transcribes Holland. The painted letters are partly discernible but dark and not wholly clear enough to verify independently from the rendered pixels. The political interpretation was not independently verified.
B-1440.strength: The annotation sits beside the crop and overview, tying the explanation to the evidence; the accessible reading order presents the images before the annotation.
B-1440.weakness: The narrow annotation column creates short lines, while considerable space remains beneath the title and button.
B-1440.repair: Give the annotation a little more width and use the available space to balance the detail and controls.

primary_action.expected: Show the egg detail and short annotation immediately.
primary_action.observed: A wider detail, marked overview and annotation appeared in the viewport without scrolling; focus stayed on the return button.

B-390.edge_observation: Enter restored the whole painting and visible focus to Inspect the egg. The overview and whole-image ring locate the egg at the lower right.
B-390.fact_check: The annotation says Holland, but the actual painted letters remain dark and only partly legible despite the larger crop. The later interpretation is not independently verified.
B-390.strength: The full-width crop gives the painted detail more space than A, while the annotation and locator remain visible immediately. The image description does not repeat the transcription.
B-390.weakness: The small overview makes the exact marked location somewhat fiddly to inspect; the image-first reading order places the annotation after both figures.
B-390.repair: Increase the locator's clarity and keep the annotation directly associated with the crop in accessible reading order.

preference.reason: Both versions complete the keyboard flow and preserve focus. B places the annotation closer to the detail on desktop and gives the mobile crop more width without hiding the annotation, while avoiding the duplicated transcription in the image description.
